model_annotation: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the "Negative log probability" across various "Per-specialty terms." The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," which include Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics arranged on a categorical scale. The vertical axis represents the values, labeled "Negative log probability," utilizing a linear scale that ranges from -22 at the top down to -27 at the bottom, with numeric tick markers regularly spaced at intervals of 1. Because the measured values are negative, the bars extend downward from the -22 mark near the top of the chart area. Within each horizontal category, there is a group of seven distinct vertical bars positioned side-by-side. The configuration corresponds to different models defined by legends located above the chart area. A top legend pairs a light blue square with "Mistralv0.2-Base." Below this, a secondary legend labeled "Fine-tuned on:" assigns a sequential gradient of six warm colors to specific specialties: Cardio (pale peach), Gastro (light orange), Infect (orange), Neuro (medium orange), Obstetrics (dark orange), and Pediatrics (dark brown). Across the chart, the light blue "Mistralv0.2-Base" bars visually extend the furthest downward in every group; their approximate values range from -23.8 in the Infect group (the visually shortest base bar) to -26.7 in the Cardio group (the longest bar overall). The six warm-colored fine-tuned model bars terminate higher up on the y-axis within every category block. For instance, in the Infect category, the fine-tuned model bars end between approximately -22.9 and -23.2, representing the set of the shortest bars on the chart. Conversely, in the Cardio category, the fine-tuned model bars end between approximately -25.7 and -26.1. The bars within each of the six groups maintain a fixed categorical sequence matching the legend order—base model followed by the fine-tuned models progressing from Cardio through Pediatrics—and are not sorted by descending or ascending numerical value. No individual bars feature special visual emphasis such as unique outlines, bolding, or direct data annotations.
